**# Instructions for Accurately Documenting Reportable Workplace Accidents**

**Important Note:**  "Reportable" accidents are defined by OSHA (or your local equivalent) and company policy. Generally, these include fatalities, illnesses, and injuries requiring medical treatment *beyond* first aid. *Know your reporting thresholds!*
